utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still here, Mara. The porch light and the loose screen door are the main things left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got it, Dane. I’ll keep track of the porch light and the loose screen door.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can take a look at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Could you check whether it powers on and tell me if you hear any unusual noise?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check it now and let you know whether it starts up and makes any odd noise.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over the spare screws and a ladder if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That would be a huge help, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for the ladder and screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll set the screws by the front door and leave the ladder in the side yard so you can grab them whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, but I’m not sure where the repair drive stands yet. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know where it’s being organized and what time the drive starts so I can figure out the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t know the exact location or start time yet, but I’m checking now so I can tell you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think the porch steps and a few loose fixtures still need attention.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, but what’s the next priority after those?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is starting up again this afternoon, and they’re still looking for a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand this afternoon, and I’ve got a couple of tools if they need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That'd be a big help, Gus, thanks. I'll let them know you've got tools and can come by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Opal. Tell me what time the repair drive starts and I’ll make sure folks hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the start time yet, so hold off on spreading that part until I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll wait for the start time before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what still needs fixing for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just the driveway lights and that loose board by the step. Can you confirm you’ve got both?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ve got both the driveway lights and the loose board by the step.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m ready to match folks up with what they can handle.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just point me at the list and I’ll grab what I can handle.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll point you to the top of the list and we’ll get you matched with something that fits.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let’s keep it simple and steady, then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep at it and help make the repair drive go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I was meant to help with that, wasn't I?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah. If you still can, I’d appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can help with that. Just point me to what needs doing and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help get the word out and keep folks coordinated. What do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly a list of the urgent stuff: broken steps, a leaky faucet, and one window that won’t close right.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, I’ll keep track of those and start with the most urgent ones.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll swing by a little later and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Dane. I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll let folks know you’ll be here later to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use help loading supplies and checking in once the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. I’ll be there to load supplies and check in when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school calendar. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning works best for me, maybe around 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 sounds good, and I should be able to help then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I can help spread the word if you want. Just tell me what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I still need donations of clean rags, screws, and anyone with a drill for the bigger fixes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll pass along the need for clean rags, screws, and a drill for the bigger fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring my drill and a few extra screws.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can grab my hammer too, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the drive listed in my notes as being at the repair lot on Maple, near the hardware store.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, that helps. I’ll note Maple near the hardware store as the repair lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, and I’ll keep that location in mind if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much longer do you think the repair drive will take?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the latest status and give you a more accurate estimate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you check it now and let me know the estimate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What do you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I need the shelves reattached and a couple of crates fixed if you can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that. I’ll get the shelves and crates reattached.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I’m mostly getting that second-hand. What did Noah say was still left to do?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think he said there’s still some cleanup and a couple of small fixes left, but I might be forgetting a bit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, so it sounds like only a little cleanup and a few small fixes are left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today. I heard folks are gathering there soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I just wanted to make sure nothing had changed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s moving along. I can check in when I’m out running errands and bring back what I learn.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, I’ll check in and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I think I can help with the repair drive, though I may be mixing up a detail or two. What time were you thinking of?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning sounds good to me. How about 9?
